Suppose h = q|H is proper. Assume that locally H is an SNC divisor in a smooth submanifold of codimension c0 − 1, and that a reduced divisor A is simultaneously SNC and transverse to those support equations. Assume that the components Hi and Aj near H have finite global smooth 141 indexing, and that every closed stratum HI ∩ AJ , with I ̸= ∅, is smooth and proper over Y and carries a global relative Kähler form.
